finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/atheros/atlx/atl1.c:2118-2145 confidence=medium conclusion=atl1_tso saves iph from the skb head, pskb_trim(skb, real_len) can call pskb_expand_head and free the old head for a cloned or frag-list GSO IPv4 frame, and the following iph->check/saddr/daddr/ihl accesses at atl1.c:2129-2145 write and read freed memory (stale-pointer UAF on TX).
coverage_gap=The heuristic save-helper-use scanner had a defect (it emitted only 1 triple for the whole tree), so candidate enumeration effectively came from the grep hit list plus manual reading; multi-line pointer derivations and pointers passed into helper functions were not systematically enumerated.
coverage_gap=Helper uses outside net/ and drivers/net/ (per the branch instruction) and macro-wrapped accessors (ipv6_hdr/ip_hdr wrappers were outside the literal grep terms) were not covered.
limitation=The atl1.c finding is a source-reading hypothesis, not a reproduction: no KASAN build, crafted GSO frame, or atl1 hardware/virtual TX path was run, so the pskb_expand_head reallocation is inferred from the skb_cloned/frag-list branch of ___pskb_trim (net/core/skbuff.c:2715-2725) rather than observed.
limitation=The stale iph dereference requires the skb to be cloned or non-linear (frag-list) at pskb_trim time; the preceding skb_cow_head(skb, 0) unclones a plain linear skb, so an unshared linear GSO frame takes the __skb_trim fast path and the pointer stays valid - the bug is latent for typical traffic and needs a cloned or frag-list GSO IPv4 frame whose tot_len is below the padded skb length.
limitation=The path is TX (ndo_start_xmit), so reachability is local transmit or forwarding of a crafted GSO frame rather than purely passive remote receive; atl1 is old L1 hardware (or its virtual counterpart) whose GSO support gates this.
limitation=The be_main.c veh->h_vlan_proto read after pskb_trim in be_lancer_xmit_workarounds was noticed during triage but classified only from the read context; it mirrors the pattern other snapshots reported (facts f006/f012) and was not read to a full conclusion in this snapshot before the finalize limit.
